data.name: Bhaasvan
data.gender_notes: Bhaasvan is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Bhaasvan is a Sanskrit name derived from 'Bhaas' meaning sun and 'van' meaning god or bearer. This name is associated with the Sun God, who is revered for his power, energy, and life-giving qualities. The name Bhaasvan carries the meaning “Sun God” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Bhaasvan usually hope their child will grow to embody sun god and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Bhaasvan belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Sun God.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Bhaasvan total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.
